Definition: to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to separate, divide; 1a) (Qal) to divide; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to divide, separate; 1b2) to be divided, be separated; 1c) (Piel) to be separated; 1d) (Pual) to be divided; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to divide, separate; 1e2) to make a division, make a separation; 1f) (Hithpael) to be divided, be separated, get separated
